title: A week of every bus, streetcar and train in Toronto
description:
A week of every bus, streetcar and train in Toronto, Monday to Sunday, in 60 seconds.

Each day is the average of that weekday in October 2026, so Saturday is a typical Saturday, not one particular one. Vehicles outside the Toronto city limits are faded and not counted.

Busiest moment: 1,720 vehicles, Tuesday at 5:10 pm.
The daily averages use every October 2026 date in each timetable and leave out Thanksgiving (October 12). October 31 is left out because the clocks change that night. GO Transit ran a reduced timetable on October 10, so that Saturday is left out. GO Transit ran a reduced timetable on October 11, so that Sunday is left out. GO Transit changed its timetables during October, so its Tuesday uses one typical date. GO Transit has fewer than three usable October Saturdays and Sundays, so its Saturday and Sunday each use one typical date. UP Express has fewer than three usable October Mondays, so its Monday uses one typical date. Durham Region Transit changed its timetables during October, so its Tuesday and Wednesday each use one typical date.
